opening.argument: The central action here is a step-by-step demonstration of building a free affiliate-marketing website on Google Sites and placing product-review content. The speaker explains how to obtain an affiliate link, and the resulting commission depends on someone purchasing the linked product. The description discloses that some links may earn a commission and qualifies income representations as aspirational, with no guaranteed results. Course access and cash are offered through a separate giveaway tied to liking the video and completing a comment, not to purchasing an affiliate product. Taken together, those facts establish an instructional demonstration with a disclosed, conditional affiliate arrangement.
